author: @iMatti_
title: Dishonest button layout
content:
Either the app doesn’t realize this or it’s purposely trying to take coins away that users accumulate. If I don’t pass a level then it comes up saying I’ve ran out of balls. I think most people are probably like me and they would instantly go to hit the “try again” button, but where it normally is is a different button that says 900 coins could be used to get five more balls. So I’ll accidentally click it because I’m just going quick. This means I lose out on the coins I wanted to save which takes about 22 levels to pass to get 900 coins, approximately. 

So my question is, does the game not realize how easy it is to mistakenly hit that button or are they trying to get us to accidentally click it which is a dishonest way to siphon our coins so that way we’ll pay for more coins? 

Just move the buttons so that way they’re in a similar area. If sometimes the screen pretty much looks the same but the button says try again, other times it gives me the option to use 900 coins, the brain starts to mix those two together. They know how to do it correctly because when someone runs out of our five lives that we can get, it gives us the option to either pay 900 coins to get five more lives or watch a commercial to get one more life/heart. They even put a little logo on each button to make it visually instantly recognizable. That’s perfect. They need to do that for what I mentioned above too. If that happens then I would give it five stars.


P.S. Also the app doesn’t actually take skill necessarily. If you fell at the level then you don’t have to learn how to improve and do it, it’ll just artificially make it easier without telling you. I don’t like that. I thought it might be doing that but I was hoping it wouldn’t, but then I got to a really hard puzzle that I couldn’t even get close to finishing and instead of trying different ways I just kept on doing the same thing over and over and eventually it just worked. That’s not what I want. I want to have to learn how to do it. So that stinks.
